items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: They had Tati, Warner and Bob. They were three brothers. Well who played the violin? Tati.

ctx.x: Bob Woodley and Tati and Warner, there was three brothers. And they had a band used to go around the French market and they used to play. One played bass, one played ghetto, another played violin. And they used to go all around the French market and play in the ballroom and things. Tati, huh? Tati. They had Tati, Warner and Bob. They were three brothers. Well who played the violin? Tati. I heard of it. Yeah, Tati. And Warner would play bass and he played at caudon. They had a caudon. They had a caudon. I don't…
What was their last name, Tati?
